author: Acceqted
body:
Hey There,

If you think your punishment is false, incorrect, or time to be appealed, you've come to the right place! Please post all appeals using this format or they will automatically be denied.

Format:


Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?:

Staff Member:

Guilty? (Yes or No):

Why do you think you should be unbanned?:

Any additional comments?:

Good luck!

*Note* Any appeals created without this specific format will be automatically denied.

Some Notes
- If you have been caught ban evading then your chances of being appealed are heavily reduced.
- You're allowed to escalate an appeal, meaning a senior moderator will take over. 
- We don't appeal infractions that are old and valid. We just don't count them.

Regards, {tag=38cc237d92724e01ad24f5b0110130c1} & {tag=89f514e1f0f549778ddc77ef030a8b46}
